description.plain:
C03 is a lightweight 1.45g and 1200TVL resolution camera that has been designed to provide superb performance for micro FPV quadcopters. It has a 2.1mm lens that gives a 160° field of view, operating in 4:3 image ratios, and features a 1/3'' CMOS sensor for clear and brilliant images. It is supplied with a BETAFPV Micro Canopy, which perfectly fits for C03 camera, making it more convenient for pilots to build quads.

Bullet Points

  • Comes with BETAFPV Micro Canopy, and 20°/30° camera mounts, which fully match the C03 camera. This bundle allows pilots to build whoop drones easily.
  • Made of high-quality ABS material and covered by BETAFPV Micro Canopy, the C03 FPV Micro Camera is durable enough for use.
  • Miniature, and lightweight design, weighing only 1.45g. Completely suitable for M03 5.8G VTX on micro whoop drone.
  • 1200TVL resolution and 1/3" CMOS sensor ensure a high-quality and clear image
  • Global WDR camera, 4:3 aspect ratio, shoot clear dynamic image even in low light condition
  • 2.1mm lens, FOV 160° beyond the wide angle for recording more wide and beautiful scenes.

    Specifications

    • Item: C03 FPV Micro Camera
    • Image Sensor: 1/3" CMOS Sensor
    • Horizontal: 1200TVL with Global WDR
    • Signal System: NTSC (4:3)
    • Lens: 2.1mm(M7) FOV 160°
    • S/N Ratio: >50db
    • Electronic Shutter Speed: Auto
    • Auto Gain Control (AGC): Auto
    • Min. Illumination: 0.01Lux@1.2F
    • D-WDR: Auto
    • Day/Night: Color
    • Power: DC 3-5.5V
    • Current: 100mA@5V / 120mA@3.3V
    • Housing Material: ABS
    • Dimension: 11*15*14mm
    • Net weight: 1.45g

    Diagram

    Plug-N-Play Connector

    C03 FPV Micro Camera features a JST-0.8 connector, a special design in plug-and-play, that makes it easy to install without soldering. Suitable for Meteor series drones, BETAFPV F4 1S 5A AIO FC, BETAFPV M03 VTX, and NBD BeeBrain flight controllers.

          Recommend Parts

          • Canopy: BETAFPV Canopy for Micro Camera 2022
          • VTX: BETAFPV M03 5.8G VTX
          • FC: BETAFPV F4 1S 5A AIO FC, NBD BeeBrain flight controllers
          • Drones: Meteor65/75 drones, or other micro whoop drones in the market.

          Package

          • 1 * C03 FPV Micro Camera
          • 1 * BETAFPV Micro Canopy
          • 1 * 20° Lens Camera Mount for C02
          • 1 * 20° Lens Camera Mount for C03
          • 1 * 30° Lens Camera Mount for C03
          • 3 * Decorative Parts
          • 4 * M1.4*5 Screws (Sliver)
          • 6 * M1.4*4 Screws (Black)

Ultra-lightweight 1.45g build enables use in micro and whoop drones without adding excess weight
Plug-and-play JST-0.8 connector allows fast, solder-free installation
Global WDR and 4:3 aspect ratio ensure dynamic, clear images in all lighting conditions
unique_selling_points: Ultra-lightweight 1.45g design with 1200TVL resolution and 160° wide-angle lens, plus plug-and-play compatibility for quick setup.

description.plain:
Caddx Ant Lite Analog FPV Camera FPVCycle Edition 4:3/16:9

The Caddx Ant Lite Analog FPV Camera FPVCycle Edition is a high-performance, lightweight FPV camera specifically designed for pilots seeking exceptional video quality and flexibility in their analog setups. This edition offers switchable aspect ratios, allowing users to toggle between 4:3 and 16:9 views, making it ideal for different flying environments and personal preferences. With its compact design and crisp, low-latency video feed, the Caddx Ant Lite delivers clear visuals even in challenging lighting conditions, ensuring you have the reliable visuals you need for precise flying.


Built with FPVCycle’s attention to quality, the Caddx Ant Lite offers a resolution that captures fine details, allowing pilots to confidently navigate through tight spaces or complex environments. Its low profile and lightweight construction make it an excellent choice for micro builds, minimizing impact on your drone's overall weight. The durable construction ensures it withstands the rigors of intense FPV flights, providing stable, dependable visuals every time.


Upgrade your FPV experience with the Caddx Ant Lite Analog FPV Camera FPVCycle Edition and enjoy the perfect blend of performance, quality, and convenience.

description.plain:
The BETAFPV C03 is a 1.45g analog FPV camera with 1200TVL resolution, 4:3 NTSC video and a 160° field of view. Input power: 3–5.5V DC. Camera dimensions: 11 × 15 × 14mm.

Uses a JST-0.8 camera connector. Confirm your board's connector, voltage and pinout before installation. BETAFPV specifies the C03 camera for the Air65 II and Air75 II analog aircraft and lists it as compatible with the Air II canopy. The Air II canopy is separate from this camera kit.

Included: one C03 camera, one BETAFPV Micro Canopy, C03 camera mounts at 20° and 30°, one C02 mount at 20°, three decorative pieces, four M1.4 × 5mm silver screws and six M1.4 × 4mm black screws.

The supplied Micro Canopy is the Micro Camera 2022 design. The Air II canopy is a separate product. Requires a compatible analog video transmitter and receiving system.

description.plain:
Runcam Nano V3 HDZero camera is small and lightweight, making it ideal for whoops and micro drones. A sharp lens with very wide FOV offers the best nano camera image quality for HDZero yet.

The camera is optimized for 4:3 aspect ratio but can be configured for 16:9 aspect ratio within the camera’s settings menu. With its large FOV lens, 16:9 cut mode offers a comfortable amount of FOV and 16:9 full mode offers a very large FOV, but with vignetting.

Nano v3 is to replace Nano v2 and Nano lite camera.

N.B: MIPI cable Not included

Check out all our Digital FPV Cameras and the rest of our HDZero Related Products!

Compared to Nano v2, Nano v3 offers:

  • Larger FOV (94° vs 89°)
  • Sharper optic
  • Reduced weight (half as heavy)

Compared to Nano lite, Nano v3 offers:

  • Larger FOV (94° vs 84°)
  • Sharper optic
  • Much clearer colors and contrast
  • Marginal weight increase (0.7g)

Specifications:

  • Sensor Size: 1/2 inch
  • Resolution: 720p @60fps 4:3
  • Shutter: Rolling Shutter
  • FOV: D:155° H:126° V:94°
  • Weight : 2.2g
  • Dimensions: L14mm x W16mm x H14mm

Package Includes:

  • 1 x HDZero Nano V3 HD FPV Camera (MIPI cable NOT included)

description.plain:
1.45 Grams. Your Quad Won't Notice.

Most micro cameras fly like you strapped on a passenger. The M1 Micro weighs 1.45g — lighter than a US penny — so the tune you spent hours dialing in stays exactly where you left it. Snap rolls stay snappy, throttle response stays crisp, and flight time doesn't take a hit. It drops into anything from a 2" toothpick to a full-size 5" freestyle rig.

Color Tuned Outdoors, Not in a Lab

Spec sheets never tell you how a camera handles the sun dropping through a treeline. RATEFPV's color profile was dialed in on real flying days: greens that look like the field you were standing on, skies that hold detail instead of blowing out, and highlight control that keeps the horizon readable when you turn straight into the sun. Natural, not oversaturated — and sharp from the first lap to the last.

Fly the Pack After Sunset

Dusk, shaded tree lines, lit night fields — highlight suppression keeps branches, gates, and landing spots defined instead of smearing into black. You stop ending the session just because the light dropped.

Built to Survive the Crash That Kills Everything Else

Every core component is glue-reinforced: it absorbs the high-frequency vibration that loosens solder joints, takes the hit when you lawn-dart into concrete, and seals out the dust and moisture that kill cameras slowly. The coated optical glass shrugs off the scratches that turn a cheap camera into a soft, milky mess after three sessions.

A cable that survives the third rebuild. 0.8mm silicone wire — bend it, route it, re-route it. Connector-free ends keep soldering quick, even in a tight build.

The Numbers Behind the Picture

  • 1/4" CMOS, 1200TVL — fine detail stays readable at speed, so you're guessing less at gates and branches.
  • 80dB WDR — pulls highlights down and lifts shadows up. Through tree lines and covered walkways, the picture doesn't black out.
  • 3DNR — filters noise out of the feed, so long sessions stop wearing on your eyes.

Picture Your Next Session

Three packs in, sun hanging low over the field, and the gate you usually lose in the glare is still right there in your goggles. You thread it, drop into the gap, and the branches you'd normally be guessing at are still readable. That's what a camera tuned for real light actually buys you — more flyable minutes out of every day you drive out to fly.

description.plain:
You already know this camera. It's the ultralight 600TVL micro cam that's become the standard for whoop racing and freestyle — same razor-sharp image, same fast analog video pipeline, same 115° field of view that gives you peripheral awareness without the fishbowl. We didn't reinvent the optics. We fixed everything around them that fails when you crash.

Epoxy-Staked Configuration Chip

This camera platform has one known weak point: the small EEPROM chip that stores the camera's image settings. Hard crashes can fatigue its tiny solder joints, and when a joint cracks, pilots see washed-out colors, a corrupted image, or a camera that stops outputting video entirely — often with no visible damage.

Every camera we ship has this chip epoxy-staked directly to the PCB, the same reinforcement technique used in aerospace electronics. Crash energy transfers through the rigid epoxy bond instead of the fragile solder joints, so the most common crash failure on this camera is addressed before it ever reaches your bench.

Bottom-Exit Wiring — Shorter Runs, Less Strain, Less Weight

We rotated the camera orientation so the wires exit from the bottom of the board instead of the side. It sounds small. It isn't:

  • Shorter wire runs. The wires point straight out above your flight controller, so you can build with less wire — saving real weight on a craft where every hundredth of a gram matters.
  • Less strain on delicate wires. Top-exit wiring gets bent, snagged, and torqued during handling, canopy installs, and crashes. Bottom-exit routing keeps the wires tucked in line with the frame, dramatically reducing the flex-cycling that kills micro camera harnesses.
  • Cleaner builds. No wire loop bulging out the top of your canopy.

Free TPU Camera Mount — In Every Box

We include a TPU camera mount with every single unit. No hunting for a compatible mount, no extra purchase, no waiting on a second shipment. Open the box, mount the cam, go fly.

Specifications

Spec Detail
Resolution 600TVL analog
Lens / FOV 115° wide-angle
Board size 11mm × 11mm single-PCB design
Input voltage 3.5V–5V
Weight (with wires & plug) ~1.4g
Weight (board only) ~1.25g
Wire exit Bottom-exit (weight-saving, strain-relieved routing)
Reinforcement Factory epoxy-staked EEPROM + impact-zone reinforcement
Connector Plug compatible with 2024/25 BetaFPV AIO 4in1 and 5in1 flight controllers
Included Camera + FREE TPU camera mount

 

What's In The Box

  • 1× Vantage FPV Camera (epoxy-staked, bottom-exit wiring)
  • 1× TPU Camera Mount — FREE

Same camera you trust. Built to take the hits.
